bf860f7ede46dd32ad8af92c.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

2544e79b350ae856431f2b66.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

4ad9c23a32e91a71a62050c3.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

f03c7d218af63ea2a33b69ac.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

a73c78dd00018417ca2ca5c0.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

9983c1dec766b9d1b287779c.text: Don't pull. My sister did that by hand.
9983c1dec766b9d1b287779c.speaker: owen
9983c1dec766b9d1b287779c.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

f9af9f597336f1658286f949.text: It says K. It doesn't say Dot.
f9af9f597336f1658286f949.speaker: lev
f9af9f597336f1658286f949.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

4cb16eb57ccb7c7cd37378c1.text: Good. Keep telling me what it says.
4cb16eb57ccb7c7cd37378c1.speaker: owen
4cb16eb57ccb7c7cd37378c1.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

b2a5f61375d54316ef2c393d.text: Someone left a glove on the seat. I don't know who.
b2a5f61375d54316ef2c393d.speaker: lev
b2a5f61375d54316ef2c393d.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

698e3bbe4f76a9b97c66afcd.text: My hands are shaking. That's all right.
698e3bbe4f76a9b97c66afcd.speaker: owen
698e3bbe4f76a9b97c66afcd.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

2b3615ef9bf832ac6c2c4249.speaker: lev
2b3615ef9bf832ac6c2c4249.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

8a6a8307d0ab8015befd08dd.text: My watch. The clock on the wall is fast.

22e9811acf748585cec49f6f.text: So the bus came at six ten?
22e9811acf748585cec49f6f.speaker: lev
22e9811acf748585cec49f6f.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

48717fc965eabff9029ca852.text: Look at the strip. Tell me what it says, even if it's different.
48717fc965eabff9029ca852.speaker: mae
48717fc965eabff9029ca852.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

8043ab3b20de0579f8e733bb.text: Just the letter, please. Leave my sister out of it.
8043ab3b20de0579f8e733bb.speaker: owen
8043ab3b20de0579f8e733bb.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

81a6e72eee47d8c407c1740b.text: People come early when it runs fast. My dad did that. I left it alone.
81a6e72eee47d8c407c1740b.speaker: mae
81a6e72eee47d8c407c1740b.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

41109a61ba27fe0db3b24723.text: The first bus leaves at six tomorrow.
41109a61ba27fe0db3b24723.speaker: lev
41109a61ba27fe0db3b24723.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

a26367ad7cace05177bc335f.text: Good. Put a little W by the wall clock.
a26367ad7cace05177bc335f.speaker: mae
a26367ad7cace05177bc335f.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

12fd60fcefa5a6b9d3633aa6.text: I'll sign the time I saw. Give me the blue pen.
12fd60fcefa5a6b9d3633aa6.speaker: mae
12fd60fcefa5a6b9d3633aa6.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

e5875c4199d8ac334508e4ff.text: I'm getting on here. Watch my hand.

e5875c4199d8ac334508e4ff.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

c96eee484ecd35eb0e8ad47a.text: You made a hole. L for lower?

c96eee484ecd35eb0e8ad47a.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

c04f3c69c086baa121c47799.text: Lower stop. Good. Now I'm getting off. What do I do to my ticket?

c04f3c69c086baa121c47799.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

aa66f76b1081db28c2ce0ad5.text: Then this mark can't tell us where someone got off.

aa66f76b1081db28c2ce0ad5.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

4b2c51c8857552aa1af0df45.text: You can put them together and see the light through both.

4b2c51c8857552aa1af0df45.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

c9e46e7f8887944445545cbf.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

ae3451994bb7c96d80755b38.text: This is the ticket I kept. The flat sides match.

ae3451994bb7c96d80755b38.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

e4a9f902c68be6b497f26d66.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

d2baa0ca1a84883756bdb36f.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

77c1f0a0c8a0954b2d2059ee.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

36e0be424e6f58403706e52e.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

7621c68f35b6ecf110728147.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

47f06aafdc3a7a1db975328c.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

bb6552c7cdd9277cadecd451.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

7e9d05d2bc9b4435afac775f.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

9e1c562ffc08647b3d7f7a80.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

d72274ff54e45ff237e54728.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

845943e79a63e70677229660.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

135ab4a44f00b69bae68289c.speaker: jo
135ab4a44f00b69bae68289c.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

b13138161e2aef72464fb552.text: We have to go across the bridge to reach the school.
b13138161e2aef72464fb552.speaker: lev
b13138161e2aef72464fb552.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

8000f5a344b0cce2417ad2cd.speaker: ruth
8000f5a344b0cce2417ad2cd.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

baf20cc04e72f6b08422c0a5.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

8778828fd94020fab39dfe33.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

463b03d6e75f7e7aa0976f92.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

b8b3048bec3ccafb598666f6.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

d13f4597bf4934c6f15616f6.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

6ee5fc580e92afa9b50344eb.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

042c19fd5c0fee85dc28ac40.speaker: ruth
042c19fd5c0fee85dc28ac40.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

4ada569a844e185ef8cb5d79.text: Why doesn't the report say that?

4ada569a844e185ef8cb5d79.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

5d5837b96f821bf51468dbc3.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

ff4bd3f423d74e7af34e874d.speaker: ruth
ff4bd3f423d74e7af34e874d.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

b58b6b1d5a212629d8920dd2.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

d55b30322705fd8fad2510e8.text: The old job board is still under the glass. Read what it called us then.
d55b30322705fd8fad2510e8.speaker: ruth
d55b30322705fd8fad2510e8.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

c12b6e9dbf89a5a91a8c7fd1.text: Put it face up. The word is small.

c12b6e9dbf89a5a91a8c7fd1.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

772bafb1016804bc321ee976.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

850ec5dc447582017792772c.text: Only when you hold it low.
850ec5dc447582017792772c.speaker: mae
850ec5dc447582017792772c.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

397cf5a0a93231c0f63f81d6.text: Don't pull the wire. It holds the glass. Turn right.
397cf5a0a93231c0f63f81d6.speaker: mae
397cf5a0a93231c0f63f81d6.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

e58b0d4e18d1792914e62879.text: What do you need a belt for?
e58b0d4e18d1792914e62879.speaker: lev
e58b0d4e18d1792914e62879.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

0111958b66ef2b1d4911f667.text: We used to buy soda through that little window. It's big enough for a belt.
0111958b66ef2b1d4911f667.speaker: nell
0111958b66ef2b1d4911f667.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

200304f5490a3f1097458c8d.text: For the latch. I'm going to open my own door.
200304f5490a3f1097458c8d.speaker: mae
200304f5490a3f1097458c8d.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

f8d80fe6e6e4fd1d2a10a053.text: The line shuts at noon tomorrow according to the notice.
f8d80fe6e6e4fd1d2a10a053.speaker: lev
f8d80fe6e6e4fd1d2a10a053.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

5c86567cf2317ad7ed040b5a.text: There. I can see the bottom of your coat.
5c86567cf2317ad7ed040b5a.speaker: mae
5c86567cf2317ad7ed040b5a.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

afcde5742a25601c487764f9.text: Good length. I'll take it round the corner.
afcde5742a25601c487764f9.speaker: nell
afcde5742a25601c487764f9.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

d683615bb85a9904cd6b7f93.text: Read me the shutdown time marked on the lower set. I need to know how long we have.
d683615bb85a9904cd6b7f93.speaker: nell
d683615bb85a9904cd6b7f93.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

98044a792374cc3334fc8446.text: Move left. There's glass on your side.
98044a792374cc3334fc8446.speaker: mae
98044a792374cc3334fc8446.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

85ce2c35e762305d46c3a765.text: Mae? Say something only you know.
85ce2c35e762305d46c3a765.speaker: lev
85ce2c35e762305d46c3a765.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

68330702e3804efaca3a1b78.text: She's got the jack. Give her room.
68330702e3804efaca3a1b78.speaker: owen
68330702e3804efaca3a1b78.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

a70d880e0423b7e5ddd1a583.text: The wall clock is three minutes fast. Now move.
a70d880e0423b7e5ddd1a583.speaker: mae
a70d880e0423b7e5ddd1a583.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

9798032dfa7b076edea6067c.text: Mae can reach the latch with the belt.
9798032dfa7b076edea6067c.speaker: lev
9798032dfa7b076edea6067c.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

ade0ba047cd188d1dcc7c118.text: Ruth has the outside key. I have a better idea. Pass me your belt.
ade0ba047cd188d1dcc7c118.speaker: mae
ade0ba047cd188d1dcc7c118.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

82d5f13c375cbaf604517e00.text: Good. The hook will hold if you keep it low.
82d5f13c375cbaf604517e00.speaker: mae
82d5f13c375cbaf604517e00.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

2538d2f96daabbf0f5e42f06.text: My desk phone used to carry polite calls. Help me turn those words into a call about this lock.
2538d2f96daabbf0f5e42f06.speaker: mae
2538d2f96daabbf0f5e42f06.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

5f791513e81e9229e2507e04.text: There. Now Owen can pass me his belt.
5f791513e81e9229e2507e04.speaker: mae
5f791513e81e9229e2507e04.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

005e08c42799460fd073e3bd.text: Thanks for not bringing the whole family.
005e08c42799460fd073e3bd.speaker: mae
005e08c42799460fd073e3bd.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

9ab74b34cdb93fa11d5d229c.speaker: lev
9ab74b34cdb93fa11d5d229c.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

e1f7d86eed7d507c05a879c1.text: They'd all give you different instructions.
e1f7d86eed7d507c05a879c1.speaker: nell
e1f7d86eed7d507c05a879c1.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

63c3a4af5888d2da8cb0ce13.text: I have the belt. Are you ready?
63c3a4af5888d2da8cb0ce13.speaker: nell
63c3a4af5888d2da8cb0ce13.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

09893630e723ccd6a6330b71.text: Ruth. Ask me again when my feet are out.
09893630e723ccd6a6330b71.speaker: mae
09893630e723ccd6a6330b71.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

cacd71e28714e4878a682691.text: Nell can hold this corner of the blanket.
cacd71e28714e4878a682691.speaker: lev
cacd71e28714e4878a682691.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

b0aa0b21d78766b5c18bc950.text: I want Lev to hold the blanket. I can move the latch from here.
b0aa0b21d78766b5c18bc950.speaker: mae
b0aa0b21d78766b5c18bc950.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

bb46fa14ef87b8abae71014f.text: Good. Keep your fingers under the cloth.
bb46fa14ef87b8abae71014f.speaker: mae
bb46fa14ef87b8abae71014f.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

76a269cd5bfc163f5f4567cf.text: Read the words beside this phone with me. Some of them finally fit the day we're having.
76a269cd5bfc163f5f4567cf.speaker: mae
76a269cd5bfc163f5f4567cf.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

ae823d2320b6d20c1847b5c3.text: On three. You count, I'll pull.
ae823d2320b6d20c1847b5c3.speaker: nell
ae823d2320b6d20c1847b5c3.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

726b935fcbd0168435e50b32.text: Keep the hat. It did good work today.
726b935fcbd0168435e50b32.speaker: mae
726b935fcbd0168435e50b32.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

db3f8a861455180eda5e638f.text: He's slower than you. Go first and turn around.
db3f8a861455180eda5e638f.speaker: mae
db3f8a861455180eda5e638f.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

fdf242fce109f3d8f16e14cc.text: So I can help him out?
fdf242fce109f3d8f16e14cc.speaker: lev
fdf242fce109f3d8f16e14cc.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

c52045a7db1a3a2e244b0aff.text: A seat behind the door and a screw in a hat. That's how you found me a way in.
c52045a7db1a3a2e244b0aff.speaker: owen
c52045a7db1a3a2e244b0aff.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

12c00fef5a43b2c7a1617102.text: Yes. I'm staying until I see his two boots outside.
12c00fef5a43b2c7a1617102.speaker: mae
12c00fef5a43b2c7a1617102.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

b98a35174509baa363422e46.text: Both boots, both knees. Everybody happy?
b98a35174509baa363422e46.speaker: owen
b98a35174509baa363422e46.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

d5f4bdee99f35aa263cdd9d1.text: Not yet. Your hand is bleeding.
d5f4bdee99f35aa263cdd9d1.speaker: mae
d5f4bdee99f35aa263cdd9d1.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

b570b854f76305a1bb2db515.speaker: lev
b570b854f76305a1bb2db515.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

d17f37ee35cd281ba4c05255.text: I'll call when Owen gets outside.
d17f37ee35cd281ba4c05255.speaker: lev
d17f37ee35cd281ba4c05255.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

01f0e10bd485347de66d4f05.text: Let me call my own name in before I answer for anybody else.
01f0e10bd485347de66d4f05.speaker: mae
01f0e10bd485347de66d4f05.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

a6461b6b9f1c656fbec4b8e5.text: Mae Rowe. Outside. Two feet on the ground.
a6461b6b9f1c656fbec4b8e5.speaker: mae
a6461b6b9f1c656fbec4b8e5.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

0b5c2d0b4161d61eca15c61a.text: Say I'm beside you. Give me the radio for my name.
0b5c2d0b4161d61eca15c61a.speaker: mae
0b5c2d0b4161d61eca15c61a.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

30d64b8864b79aa714ca9032.text: That's one mark I don't want to rub out.
30d64b8864b79aa714ca9032.speaker: nell
30d64b8864b79aa714ca9032.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

e8ff332136a882bc2afa0210.text: Leave it scratched. We know someone heard it today.
e8ff332136a882bc2afa0210.speaker: ada
e8ff332136a882bc2afa0210.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

34e598cd6eef9f8f56056109.text: Ada, I see one boot. I need to see two.
34e598cd6eef9f8f56056109.speaker: mae
34e598cd6eef9f8f56056109.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

d2330856eb7fb8422b27bc16.text: Do you want me to tell Ruth?
d2330856eb7fb8422b27bc16.speaker: lev
d2330856eb7fb8422b27bc16.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

8d108484d327740b3ffdd453.text: Two boots, one old woman. I'm out.
8d108484d327740b3ffdd453.speaker: ada
8d108484d327740b3ffdd453.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

5106728c810f5d9a97f0e51f.text: Tell her where I am. I'll say my own name.
5106728c810f5d9a97f0e51f.speaker: mae
5106728c810f5d9a97f0e51f.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

75935a50a39be08def2bb1c7.text: Sit here. The board is dry.
75935a50a39be08def2bb1c7.speaker: nell
75935a50a39be08def2bb1c7.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

d3f048458f7e6df17b3f227b.text: I'll call when Ada gets outside.
d3f048458f7e6df17b3f227b.speaker: lev
d3f048458f7e6df17b3f227b.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

0b8b1085e9efa9435bf5589f.text: First I want to feel the dirt. I forgot how good dirt feels.
0b8b1085e9efa9435bf5589f.speaker: mae
0b8b1085e9efa9435bf5589f.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

81435435721049a7e77297f3.text: Mae Rowe. I'm outside. I have people with me.
81435435721049a7e77297f3.speaker: mae
81435435721049a7e77297f3.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

ed29f68bc87303cb00d2962b.text: Say where we are. Then give me the radio.
ed29f68bc87303cb00d2962b.speaker: mae
ed29f68bc87303cb00d2962b.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

696e280bcaf6c975dac1bff6.speaker: mae
696e280bcaf6c975dac1bff6.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

8247d8327eb9480600dd6ce4.text: I can live with a door that has two sides.
8247d8327eb9480600dd6ce4.speaker: mae
8247d8327eb9480600dd6ce4.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

ed3389b112eed2e72d9cab76.text: The creek stays off the clean copy. The door is yours.
ed3389b112eed2e72d9cab76.speaker: nell
ed3389b112eed2e72d9cab76.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

5437ecc776b4299555fbeb0a.text: We can talk about the floor. It's warm near the stove.
5437ecc776b4299555fbeb0a.speaker: lev
5437ecc776b4299555fbeb0a.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

e0e02a452fd19dc546a73b25.text: I put in that wire. Next time I'll ask what it's for before I hide it under a seat.
e0e02a452fd19dc546a73b25.speaker: owen
e0e02a452fd19dc546a73b25.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

160c7cb28a65f70bc5399f58.text: They keep asking how I feel. I feel the floor. That's all I can say.
160c7cb28a65f70bc5399f58.speaker: mae
160c7cb28a65f70bc5399f58.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

5a0b45a3f828907a5f24749b.speaker: lev
5a0b45a3f828907a5f24749b.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

8f1304b1861d5043a3f4e695.text: The other room was cold. I counted the tiles to keep my head clear.
8f1304b1861d5043a3f4e695.speaker: mae
8f1304b1861d5043a3f4e695.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

6e2dd86227aae0d99e82efb4.text: Twenty and a half. I like to get the half right.
6e2dd86227aae0d99e82efb4.speaker: mae
6e2dd86227aae0d99e82efb4.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

b2f1925696836cc19386effe.text: You should sit by the warm stove if you want.
b2f1925696836cc19386effe.speaker: lev
b2f1925696836cc19386effe.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

bbd55fbb0f4526e6fd1487ac.text: Read back what I marked on the body card. I'll tell you what I can feel.
bbd55fbb0f4526e6fd1487ac.speaker: mae
bbd55fbb0f4526e6fd1487ac.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

22710edb3c31086247e75eb4.text: Start where your left foot is. We can stop when I want.
22710edb3c31086247e75eb4.speaker: mae
22710edb3c31086247e75eb4.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

d8538c8716899cfe6bca283a.text: Stay where I can see your feet. It's a strange thing to ask.
d8538c8716899cfe6bca283a.speaker: mae
d8538c8716899cfe6bca283a.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

4905aca12074831b0b6d6f5e.text: Did you want to scare Owen?
4905aca12074831b0b6d6f5e.speaker: lev
4905aca12074831b0b6d6f5e.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

1504baf5cd01bcab3612e3b8.speaker: lev
1504baf5cd01bcab3612e3b8.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

3e44fd416b89c8c788848063.text: I put Dot's voice on the bus. I had the school tape and the key to the desk.
3e44fd416b89c8c788848063.speaker: mae
3e44fd416b89c8c788848063.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

c4c0a3bff4586d48684e3044.text: I wanted Ilya to look up. I thought his face would tell me who had changed the list.
c4c0a3bff4586d48684e3044.speaker: mae
c4c0a3bff4586d48684e3044.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

5c5574302c0e88f21a34ef5d.text: Mae played the school tape on Friday night.
5c5574302c0e88f21a34ef5d.speaker: lev
5c5574302c0e88f21a34ef5d.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

3870d5c9e6901c47fbb20bb6.text: It told me I could hurt two people with one word. It told me nothing about the list.
3870d5c9e6901c47fbb20bb6.speaker: mae
3870d5c9e6901c47fbb20bb6.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

ea27589d34692704ba2f641f.text: He's in the hall. I can start there.
ea27589d34692704ba2f641f.speaker: mae
ea27589d34692704ba2f641f.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

0b5acb3504bf2bcabf8150b8.text: I tried writing an apology. Will you read it as I wrote it?
0b5acb3504bf2bcabf8150b8.speaker: mae
0b5acb3504bf2bcabf8150b8.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

0275fc7ad76d7d50f371430c.text: Don't make it easy for me. Stay while I tell him.
0275fc7ad76d7d50f371430c.speaker: mae
0275fc7ad76d7d50f371430c.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

43ba02269c218854f985a10e.text: You used my sister's voice like a spare key.
43ba02269c218854f985a10e.speaker: owen
43ba02269c218854f985a10e.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

c9519fad4b7c7c3cb25e9bfc.text: I did. I didn't ask you. I didn't ask Nell.
c9519fad4b7c7c3cb25e9bfc.speaker: mae
c9519fad4b7c7c3cb25e9bfc.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

9b1e185f08bd7a1faabe851f.text: And now we're all supposed to be glad you're alive.
9b1e185f08bd7a1faabe851f.speaker: owen
9b1e185f08bd7a1faabe851f.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

820e95ae8855db749b8f47c1.text: You can be angry and still bring me an apple.
820e95ae8855db749b8f47c1.speaker: mae
820e95ae8855db749b8f47c1.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

cf18be763f929fe80bae9ccd.text: I'll put it here between you.
cf18be763f929fe80bae9ccd.speaker: lev
cf18be763f929fe80bae9ccd.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

4bff883908a602e8e2da7121.text: I brought this one for me. You can have the big piece.
4bff883908a602e8e2da7121.speaker: owen
4bff883908a602e8e2da7121.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

07aeb03e78743f13d6e4cdab.speaker: lev
07aeb03e78743f13d6e4cdab.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

958710f57d040d48c44e4399.text: Read Dot's apple recipe before you cut the last piece.
958710f57d040d48c44e4399.speaker: owen
958710f57d040d48c44e4399.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

cac85fcb1acb4f8e891ddaca.text: You heard me hit the door.
cac85fcb1acb4f8e891ddaca.speaker: mae
cac85fcb1acb4f8e891ddaca.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

1e7c2dbdd1b04d3ba721523e.text: Uneven pieces are fine, Lev. Nobody's counting.
1e7c2dbdd1b04d3ba721523e.speaker: mae
1e7c2dbdd1b04d3ba721523e.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

42ae4f277fb85fa93ca37f24.text: Keep the door open. I want the room to feel bigger.
42ae4f277fb85fa93ca37f24.speaker: owen
42ae4f277fb85fa93ca37f24.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

fb891bd9b1caa02193c67b39.text: I shut the lower door on you. I was going back for the report.
fb891bd9b1caa02193c67b39.speaker: ruth
fb891bd9b1caa02193c67b39.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

f20fe7f88191a973b27a925f.text: Yes. Then the bank fell into the road. I waited too long to tell anyone.
f20fe7f88191a973b27a925f.speaker: ruth
f20fe7f88191a973b27a925f.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

751f896aac51dff3516d7fc7.text: Why did you lock the door?
751f896aac51dff3516d7fc7.speaker: lev
751f896aac51dff3516d7fc7.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

e3149893e12522cda39d73af.text: Were you afraid of the road or afraid of us?
e3149893e12522cda39d73af.speaker: lev
e3149893e12522cda39d73af.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

1a4cb56a450d91403af8eff2.text: Both. Write both. I don't get a smaller word for the second one.
1a4cb56a450d91403af8eff2.speaker: ruth
1a4cb56a450d91403af8eff2.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

94015b36f44ace9c58ee5c6e.text: My note from the lower room is private, but I'll read this part with you.

f31a829cf359b95262ce2c5d.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

d2eaa814eafb153da5bd43de.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

91c35d8f0b7ecd3ec35d0c4d.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

5348a2bbbbbeb8571410ab2d.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

bd4a95a60c92bd8231934a02.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

17d98f65dcaa86c3fc1e97ed.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

108ad6bf29f823365828b415.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

1425ecf909c11ecd465db2e2.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

aa3256d76d40c5d7383403ef.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

c88e139e566a3ec56ee9dfb1.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

5cbee4ad1f0419ecf6752a7b.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

df456e3628e25ba2af502c72.text: Is the empty part where he was?

df456e3628e25ba2af502c72.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

5036864ef39582708e4c539e.text: It's where I didn't know how to draw him. Please don't use it as proof.
5036864ef39582708e4c539e.speaker: jo
5036864ef39582708e4c539e.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

56066df84391857ea096b01f.text: Can I still keep the picture in the book?
56066df84391857ea096b01f.speaker: lev
56066df84391857ea096b01f.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

4fdc529f0a07f5ebf36e080c.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

00713502f69b737239e89855.text: Yes. Write that I was ten. A child is allowed a white space.
00713502f69b737239e89855.speaker: jo
00713502f69b737239e89855.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

db4c48f231aaf096694ee9b0.text: Read the top of my old school test. It's the drawing below it that's mine.
db4c48f231aaf096694ee9b0.speaker: jo
db4c48f231aaf096694ee9b0.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

7ddc792070c37a844e80c2e4.text: That feels like the right place. Mark the year on the folder.
7ddc792070c37a844e80c2e4.speaker: jo
7ddc792070c37a844e80c2e4.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

52194a4dd202a6df626a52b8.text: I was trying to say “Move your bag.” Did you hear that instead?

52194a4dd202a6df626a52b8.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

f7fc9961937e994605f96b76.text: Put my words under it. Don't put them in my father's mouth.
f7fc9961937e994605f96b76.speaker: jo
f7fc9961937e994605f96b76.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

84945da21cffe5b24f67f9f0.text: I heard three words. Your lips didn't move at first.

84945da21cffe5b24f67f9f0.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

b8da0d36c883438d6c43ff7a.text: I could feel cold water in my mouth. The hose was in my hand.

b8da0d36c883438d6c43ff7a.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

bb1ffcf09ce1bed242fb34df.text: Ask me my own name. Not anybody else's.

bb1ffcf09ce1bed242fb34df.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

30d35fbeacc84eee85a78eab.text: I was washing the bus when I heard the words.

30d35fbeacc84eee85a78eab.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

d1f1c2e779c241771b950003.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

0078582e91d746cb689c7733.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

af1326f82b94474766760bfc.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

482162a82a284cdc766abdc8.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

f9c52e7b4dc67efc5f124875.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

6e68fceb831c20a8a76307e8.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

5471261a5824a389bda9c397.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

31a648a3754df5a35ca6f7dd.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

c731e006b0f1608b21cbc745.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

3c84a2d5dae339138735a9ab.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

d58a03931eaf326d4ee12d81.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

1a65602266160f337de4a78f.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

d4856d9a8fee69c88ba4c2dc.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

201bc25647d501e8c3aa5b31.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

842d974a39a81e79ed7a8084.speaker: ada
842d974a39a81e79ed7a8084.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

3d4bdd52b7f95ffdc321a5bc.text: Your own words. I wrote that down.
3d4bdd52b7f95ffdc321a5bc.speaker: lev
3d4bdd52b7f95ffdc321a5bc.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

d726472cd8c57f532c5dbef1.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

07a8d86384c5f22e2dd7ca2c.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

ce52f9429c0882ba52dc2ae5.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

90a70e3b06e612f05a956272.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

78ccc82778dc4fb01e681f33.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

5f42eaabd6322a42487457ba.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

4640671d146056141fe677bb.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

e2ceefb6c9e836f8076d289d.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

46145c8197ccaaf349c66561.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

8b1fe197d78be317805850a9.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

c9e44d8de0e5c592f2d455fb.speaker: ruth
c9e44d8de0e5c592f2d455fb.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

b2891a35765448fb165a9a9a.speaker: lev
b2891a35765448fb165a9a9a.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

8f8361f9cf93352b9ff9342f.text: I'll write that we lost the copy. I won't write the names from memory on a new one.
8f8361f9cf93352b9ff9342f.speaker: lev
8f8361f9cf93352b9ff9342f.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

4d3fd1eabd0a27a3533e620e.text: The water came through the floor. The original was in the bottom drawer. Look at it now.
4d3fd1eabd0a27a3533e620e.speaker: ruth
4d3fd1eabd0a27a3533e620e.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

a1bcac18f0aae33a22d5c169.speaker: ruth
a1bcac18f0aae33a22d5c169.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

8d46718fcc4800c7f303d04d.text: Can we keep the wet paper too?
8d46718fcc4800c7f303d04d.speaker: lev
8d46718fcc4800c7f303d04d.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

b32d07655b423f650df3ba2a.text: We know where you left the clean copy. Let's check that place before we say anything.
b32d07655b423f650df3ba2a.speaker: jo
b32d07655b423f650df3ba2a.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

e40c0ce91e4686a39469bc31.text: Yes. Something happened to it. That's a fact we can keep.
e40c0ce91e4686a39469bc31.speaker: ruth
e40c0ce91e4686a39469bc31.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

fbd149863515178d8de226c3.text: There are fewer dry pages in this tray.
fbd149863515178d8de226c3.speaker: lev
fbd149863515178d8de226c3.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

540053944f5399f3063562b1.text: Lay it flat. We'll write down where the water came from.
540053944f5399f3063562b1.speaker: ruth
540053944f5399f3063562b1.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

82c13f0a5f3766bac26c463a.text: Read the notes on the wet tray. Keep the numbers clear.
82c13f0a5f3766bac26c463a.speaker: ruth
82c13f0a5f3766bac26c463a.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

3ec764d1b8fc57f9f6b7e280.text: Keep the door in the picture. It shows how high the water was.
3ec764d1b8fc57f9f6b7e280.speaker: jo
3ec764d1b8fc57f9f6b7e280.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

64b675ffe7ff74497dd7e589.text: I thought you wouldn't come if I called.
64b675ffe7ff74497dd7e589.speaker: mae
64b675ffe7ff74497dd7e589.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

a719fa88749764dc26259ec4.speaker: mae
a719fa88749764dc26259ec4.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

bca4275d3a6b1d44934fe8f7.text: I don't pick up for people who steal family tapes. You used the other copy. It still felt like stealing.
bca4275d3a6b1d44934fe8f7.speaker: nell
bca4275d3a6b1d44934fe8f7.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

1fc24890250b3dd0c9fe8650.text: Do you want the needle or the radio?
1fc24890250b3dd0c9fe8650.speaker: lev
1fc24890250b3dd0c9fe8650.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

3f102b20f72b13217523cd09.text: Ask next time. That's a future I can do something with.
3f102b20f72b13217523cd09.speaker: nell
3f102b20f72b13217523cd09.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

8c9e85ae0464f060c668a108.text: The needle. I'll put the radio down for one minute.
8c9e85ae0464f060c668a108.speaker: mae
8c9e85ae0464f060c668a108.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

be563733bb7c6743a00d3ad6.text: Nell agreed to share the empty case, not the voice.
be563733bb7c6743a00d3ad6.speaker: lev
be563733bb7c6743a00d3ad6.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

e342ede9096860a2e2f87113.text: Read the cloth labels to Mae. I can't thread a needle and read small print at once.
e342ede9096860a2e2f87113.speaker: nell
e342ede9096860a2e2f87113.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

edbea8a7c35795261dba92e8.speaker: ilya
edbea8a7c35795261dba92e8.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

358fcf2c5750354c51e0789c.text: If it rings for me, hand it over. I'll answer myself.
358fcf2c5750354c51e0789c.speaker: nell
358fcf2c5750354c51e0789c.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

a4a07e7e4fb9d4310c6dacfa.text: Thanks. My eyes aren't ready for tiny things yet.
a4a07e7e4fb9d4310c6dacfa.speaker: mae
a4a07e7e4fb9d4310c6dacfa.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

179ec4197b14ceb436fe632e.text: One finger. Then you put the light out.
179ec4197b14ceb436fe632e.speaker: lev
179ec4197b14ceb436fe632e.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

d41249303e50aab54299c9e8.text: I wasn't afraid of the dark. I was afraid of what I could do while you could see me.
d41249303e50aab54299c9e8.speaker: ilya
d41249303e50aab54299c9e8.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

9cb79dd94b7b700c7a9fcc68.text: I can sit on this step all night. You sat beside me once.
9cb79dd94b7b700c7a9fcc68.speaker: owen
9cb79dd94b7b700c7a9fcc68.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

72495dd6101a702ce6d923f3.text: Can I bring a light back?
72495dd6101a702ce6d923f3.speaker: lev
72495dd6101a702ce6d923f3.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

e0ab0d25499e5213f5c6aed3.text: I will point the light at the wall for you.
e0ab0d25499e5213f5c6aed3.speaker: lev
e0ab0d25499e5213f5c6aed3.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

a39ea2c6154c9db899ea08c9.text: A small one. Ask before you turn it on.
a39ea2c6154c9db899ea08c9.speaker: ilya
a39ea2c6154c9db899ea08c9.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

4e8bc1ba62263530f80c3f56.text: Tell me where your chair is. I can hear better if I know.
4e8bc1ba62263530f80c3f56.speaker: ilya
4e8bc1ba62263530f80c3f56.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

4b1cc6362eef666115247826.text: There's an old card from my last visit. Help me read the dates and words separately.
4b1cc6362eef666115247826.speaker: ilya
4b1cc6362eef666115247826.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

5d96060ed440ce318b6629e2.text: Yes. Face it at the wall. I don't want it in my eyes.
5d96060ed440ce318b6629e2.speaker: ilya
5d96060ed440ce318b6629e2.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

86c9427801c804492a0fb760.text: The creek is coming back toward us. Something is blocking it below.
86c9427801c804492a0fb760.speaker: nell
86c9427801c804492a0fb760.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

602e678e0acda87a9d033603.speaker: lev
602e678e0acda87a9d033603.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

78f3591be4b7937f320f1e8b.text: For feet, maybe. Not for a bus.
78f3591be4b7937f320f1e8b.speaker: nell
78f3591be4b7937f320f1e8b.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

9b6a743e0481cbb9bf8f2064.text: Can we ask people to say their own names?
9b6a743e0481cbb9bf8f2064.speaker: lev
9b6a743e0481cbb9bf8f2064.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

0efdebd992b6811cadb740cf.text: I've closed both ends. I want a name from every person who comes through.
0efdebd992b6811cadb740cf.speaker: ruth
0efdebd992b6811cadb740cf.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

cd36348864b7a82b397434b2.text: That's a better order than my old one.
cd36348864b7a82b397434b2.speaker: ruth
cd36348864b7a82b397434b2.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

b54dc51172616a19925c069f.text: Look at that water. It is going to cover the road.
b54dc51172616a19925c069f.speaker: lev
b54dc51172616a19925c069f.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

8b5d9f32afff7ba76753516b.text: Before we move the teams, read the class map beside the local water map.
8b5d9f32afff7ba76753516b.speaker: nell
8b5d9f32afff7ba76753516b.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

8a54d61eb3173ed4cf900d77.text: Put the time beside it. Water can move while we're talking.
8a54d61eb3173ed4cf900d77.speaker: nell
8a54d61eb3173ed4cf900d77.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

906dcf794a2fd1483c7b5f61.text: Ask them to keep the footpath open for the guides.
906dcf794a2fd1483c7b5f61.speaker: ruth
906dcf794a2fd1483c7b5f61.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

5b20209084406f85bbeacb94.text: Grandpa said it meant bad weather.
5b20209084406f85bbeacb94.speaker: nell
5b20209084406f85bbeacb94.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

90430a220c188862cd69b3e3.text: Which meaning do you use when you walk?
90430a220c188862cd69b3e3.speaker: lev
90430a220c188862cd69b3e3.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

a787c9c218b688b9fa8382cc.text: Both. Check the sky and let each person speak.
a787c9c218b688b9fa8382cc.speaker: nell
a787c9c218b688b9fa8382cc.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

f1b5555103b4f777a8871905.text: That's a longer walk. It's a good one.
f1b5555103b4f777a8871905.speaker: ada
f1b5555103b4f777a8871905.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

c32959829f95b052c8a22c36.text: He was my father. We could disagree even when he was alive.
c32959829f95b052c8a22c36.speaker: ada
c32959829f95b052c8a22c36.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

81a7739e7a5570eadadab844.text: Two marks tell us somebody went out and came back. This little one says they heard a voice from behind.
81a7739e7a5570eadadab844.speaker: ada
81a7739e7a5570eadadab844.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

4f8de90c536c49994705eccc.text: We may draw the two big ones.
4f8de90c536c49994705eccc.speaker: lev
4f8de90c536c49994705eccc.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

ce4bf04cfd61c549db54af49.text: Yes. Leave the little one with us for now.
ce4bf04cfd61c549db54af49.speaker: ada
ce4bf04cfd61c549db54af49.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

4695b1ea9313eb431d1cd04d.text: The kids' cards have pictures from two places. Read the little note on the back.
4695b1ea9313eb431d1cd04d.speaker: ada
4695b1ea9313eb431d1cd04d.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

ebc16fdb2d30d5b2a612240d.text: At each turn, stop and see the face beside you.
ebc16fdb2d30d5b2a612240d.speaker: nell
ebc16fdb2d30d5b2a612240d.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

01ddabb2d49f01c872e91b91.text: You left the creek off once. I trust your pencil to do it again.
01ddabb2d49f01c872e91b91.speaker: nell
01ddabb2d49f01c872e91b91.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

0df5fb7dcbddd693ab8fb35f.text: Can I send your whole map to the teams?
0df5fb7dcbddd693ab8fb35f.speaker: ruth
0df5fb7dcbddd693ab8fb35f.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

7343c0f732df7c5e591f5e7d.text: You learned my route. Today you learn hers. This light has a full battery.
7343c0f732df7c5e591f5e7d.speaker: owen
7343c0f732df7c5e591f5e7d.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

c2fd6b86a947ca582835b088.text: If you get hurt, they need a way out.
c2fd6b86a947ca582835b088.speaker: ruth
c2fd6b86a947ca582835b088.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

1eee3896ec4ad913e3c8817c.text: Give them the public turn. I can take them through the rest.
1eee3896ec4ad913e3c8817c.speaker: nell
1eee3896ec4ad913e3c8817c.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

1c11fc3bd9f015c9c5507a46.text: Then train a second guide. You don't need to put my family's meeting place on every wall.
1c11fc3bd9f015c9c5507a46.speaker: nell
1c11fc3bd9f015c9c5507a46.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

c715ee180662ab185e5809b9.text: Look at you. That was almost a joke.
c715ee180662ab185e5809b9.speaker: nell
c715ee180662ab185e5809b9.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

f77933b283b494936393bbcf.text: I know somebody who can follow directions.
f77933b283b494936393bbcf.speaker: lev
f77933b283b494936393bbcf.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

7463469b6a56e379d138ff40.text: Can I draw the public turn for Ruth?
7463469b6a56e379d138ff40.speaker: lev
7463469b6a56e379d138ff40.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

cb869d1e53323c3c9b7108f5.text: Read the directions I can share while Ruth draws the public turn.
cb869d1e53323c3c9b7108f5.speaker: nell
cb869d1e53323c3c9b7108f5.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

1eba41cc2f92e20ce1c37c91.text: You're my second pair of eyes. Start at the red post.
1eba41cc2f92e20ce1c37c91.speaker: nell
1eba41cc2f92e20ce1c37c91.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

8531027baccb5ca6ef74d5e4.text: I'll send only this part. Sign the edge you approved.
8531027baccb5ca6ef74d5e4.speaker: ruth
8531027baccb5ca6ef74d5e4.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

226cbd3547fb4ed94c5da4e3.text: Does it make that sound every time?
226cbd3547fb4ed94c5da4e3.speaker: lev
226cbd3547fb4ed94c5da4e3.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

dca5a86b5e148dd06ade0884.text: She gave me this when I left Russia. I used it on my first day here.
dca5a86b5e148dd06ade0884.speaker: ilya
dca5a86b5e148dd06ade0884.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

2b3d31733b609b49f737501d.speaker: lev
2b3d31733b609b49f737501d.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

3dd62f92814bf24235754b61.text: Only against this wall. Only when I'm tired, I used to think.
3dd62f92814bf24235754b61.speaker: ilya
3dd62f92814bf24235754b61.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

e75add2ca6b1adaca8db8c06.text: Ilya has kept the cup since he left Russia.
e75add2ca6b1adaca8db8c06.speaker: lev
e75add2ca6b1adaca8db8c06.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

d0d5ab81508515123259a945.text: I think I owe my sister a call while the voice I have is mine.
d0d5ab81508515123259a945.speaker: ilya
d0d5ab81508515123259a945.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

025b8bcfff5aad1d3a7095f8.text: Anna left this note for you. Read part of it while I set her cup down.
025b8bcfff5aad1d3a7095f8.speaker: ilya
025b8bcfff5aad1d3a7095f8.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

41e0fef232d1a8d732722c9f.text: Stay close enough to hear me ask for Anna myself.
41e0fef232d1a8d732722c9f.speaker: ilya
41e0fef232d1a8d732722c9f.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

19fddf82e0bf7ffdeab7c0d8.text: Now we can hear the phone without the cup.
19fddf82e0bf7ffdeab7c0d8.speaker: ilya
19fddf82e0bf7ffdeab7c0d8.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

e57d11a4ff8ceb04ff7bbdf8.text: We have one crew before the rain. The back exit needs a rope and a light.
e57d11a4ff8ceb04ff7bbdf8.speaker: nell
e57d11a4ff8ceb04ff7bbdf8.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

511922f0cae08bb42348f386.text: The school roof needs hands too. Kids sleep there tonight.
511922f0cae08bb42348f386.speaker: jo
511922f0cae08bb42348f386.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

2b469a6a14999553dd66828b.text: Choose where our crew goes. I'll send whoever I can spare to the other job.
2b469a6a14999553dd66828b.speaker: ruth
2b469a6a14999553dd66828b.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

18a4283af2d6d6b4fc0f7d73.text: Will the other job be ready in time?
18a4283af2d6d6b4fc0f7d73.speaker: lev
18a4283af2d6d6b4fc0f7d73.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

607aac52198c463138dd655f.text: I can't promise that. I can tell you who will be there.
607aac52198c463138dd655f.speaker: ruth
607aac52198c463138dd655f.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

9a4ee58abe974c2fe9282b3d.text: We have enough time for one job before the rain.
9a4ee58abe974c2fe9282b3d.speaker: lev
9a4ee58abe974c2fe9282b3d.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

3b0ab16a986f24efdc2ec0ec.text: Tell the second crew what is in this kit. They have to feel the right rope in the dark.
3b0ab16a986f24efdc2ec0ec.speaker: nell
3b0ab16a986f24efdc2ec0ec.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

c6dde6d6c554a7be78942cf7.text: Even this bed by the wall is dry tonight.
c6dde6d6c554a7be78942cf7.speaker: jo
c6dde6d6c554a7be78942cf7.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

f26dd58b77da8cb9a8d37a07.text: We'll put the cots under a dry roof. The back steps will have to wait.
f26dd58b77da8cb9a8d37a07.speaker: jo
f26dd58b77da8cb9a8d37a07.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

8d9a1537deb21c9e55ab4671.text: We lost two dry beds at the wall. The children can stay in the middle.
8d9a1537deb21c9e55ab4671.speaker: jo
8d9a1537deb21c9e55ab4671.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

fc71e04c71339e0c6dc3b3cf.text: I'll fix the rope. When a light goes out, the rope stays.
fc71e04c71339e0c6dc3b3cf.speaker: nell
fc71e04c71339e0c6dc3b3cf.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

6b043209acefb2ecc3506b3d.text: The back steps still need a rope.
6b043209acefb2ecc3506b3d.speaker: ruth
6b043209acefb2ecc3506b3d.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

0e942f7503f4d930b217fffb.text: When you get old, everybody calls fear a bad night's sleep.
0e942f7503f4d930b217fffb.speaker: ada
0e942f7503f4d930b217fffb.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

d7232285ca211a584a59c9c8.text: What would you like me to call it?
d7232285ca211a584a59c9c8.speaker: mae
d7232285ca211a584a59c9c8.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

83a1cc58fb4f6dc8f2ad20d1.text: Fear. Then ask what I need.
83a1cc58fb4f6dc8f2ad20d1.speaker: ada
83a1cc58fb4f6dc8f2ad20d1.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

ccd49837e0789bff93e4a74f.speaker: lev
ccd49837e0789bff93e4a74f.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

277aeb2de0206b8304df0e5b.speaker: mae
277aeb2de0206b8304df0e5b.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

a777f82889d6af830870fd68.text: Mae is staying with Ada for the first hour tonight.
a777f82889d6af830870fd68.speaker: lev
a777f82889d6af830870fd68.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

63324bc3e9f3bfa084e19f9d.text: A chair by the door. If I hear Ben, I want to see a living face before I speak.
63324bc3e9f3bfa084e19f9d.speaker: ada
63324bc3e9f3bfa084e19f9d.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

a5afb1302a199151a1db489e.text: Read the room card to Ada, then ask her what she wants.
a5afb1302a199151a1db489e.speaker: mae
a5afb1302a199151a1db489e.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

48d436a2cccb301fc75f03d3.text: Face it toward me. I want to see the eyes.
48d436a2cccb301fc75f03d3.speaker: ada
48d436a2cccb301fc75f03d3.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

e3ac308304d717e2a9a0307d.text: I said I would. Put the next name under mine.
e3ac308304d717e2a9a0307d.speaker: mae
e3ac308304d717e2a9a0307d.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

4271ce2a4e7b9bcc4286f7c5.text: How many old sides are there?
4271ce2a4e7b9bcc4286f7c5.speaker: lev
4271ce2a4e7b9bcc4286f7c5.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

1ff7f24ecd02771a607ef20c.text: The old side came up when the board fell. There's a reason for this one.
1ff7f24ecd02771a607ef20c.speaker: ruth
1ff7f24ecd02771a607ef20c.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

4ef24464c77f53ee62ad3084.text: Three. We used anything we had after the slide.
4ef24464c77f53ee62ad3084.speaker: ruth
4ef24464c77f53ee62ad3084.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

8be18edee59b6129a4fd1197.text: You kept the old names under the new ones?
8be18edee59b6129a4fd1197.speaker: mae
8be18edee59b6129a4fd1197.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

3897d827ab1c495952fbc243.text: Yes. I told myself it was cheaper.
3897d827ab1c495952fbc243.speaker: ruth
3897d827ab1c495952fbc243.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

d40007107351faf176d9c794.text: We can give today's people clean labels.
d40007107351faf176d9c794.speaker: lev
d40007107351faf176d9c794.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

c47db4cfc2c70924f767f70c.text: These labels were used in the old school.
c47db4cfc2c70924f767f70c.speaker: lev
c47db4cfc2c70924f767f70c.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

813068d5e08b282a807eafa6.text: Give each person a pen. They can write their own name.
813068d5e08b282a807eafa6.speaker: mae
813068d5e08b282a807eafa6.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

fda2bf1d8d6f40aa8cfeea9e.text: Keep the names readable on the table. History can wait here.
fda2bf1d8d6f40aa8cfeea9e.speaker: ruth
fda2bf1d8d6f40aa8cfeea9e.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

e0d27bb172a572dafe48fce4.text: Read the little training card beside the magnets. Every person writes their own name.
e0d27bb172a572dafe48fce4.speaker: ruth
e0d27bb172a572dafe48fce4.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

04495dc852308d4767be7c63.text: Closed. I heard my name from the hole.
04495dc852308d4767be7c63.speaker: lev
04495dc852308d4767be7c63.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

263f1b9bb216dc1d0158baac.text: I didn't call you. Look at me. Where are my lips?
263f1b9bb216dc1d0158baac.speaker: nell
263f1b9bb216dc1d0158baac.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

e9d08f596c79bfeb7b247202.text: Now wait until you see me speak. Lev.
e9d08f596c79bfeb7b247202.speaker: nell
e9d08f596c79bfeb7b247202.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

9199684867b5e961f95ec485.text: You might not next time. That's why we walk with somebody.
9199684867b5e961f95ec485.speaker: nell
9199684867b5e961f95ec485.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

e4328c1b3a3e226dde996ddc.text: Here. I can hear the difference now.
e4328c1b3a3e226dde996ddc.speaker: lev
e4328c1b3a3e226dde996ddc.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

aebdc4f1d0a1140e10d94c4b.speaker: nell
aebdc4f1d0a1140e10d94c4b.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

172aec08dc39721229278051.text: Can we let the next person choose their own pace?
172aec08dc39721229278051.speaker: lev
172aec08dc39721229278051.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

146a71bf3328d5e305cfbb59.text: If I hear my name again, I'll look at your face.
146a71bf3328d5e305cfbb59.speaker: lev
146a71bf3328d5e305cfbb59.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

cae6ae671170f4670f9cf594.text: Read the weather message out loud at the bend. Everyone should hear the same words.
cae6ae671170f4670f9cf594.speaker: nell
cae6ae671170f4670f9cf594.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

92924b4622658cd1e978a97a.text: Let them set the pace. We'll wait at the bend.
92924b4622658cd1e978a97a.speaker: nell
92924b4622658cd1e978a97a.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

a8002b463fc84e79a9df29a7.text: One open hand means stop. Let everyone try it.
a8002b463fc84e79a9df29a7.speaker: nell
a8002b463fc84e79a9df29a7.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

37c46e07a4a92a9e1fafe7c3.text: What do you want me to tell them?
37c46e07a4a92a9e1fafe7c3.speaker: lev
37c46e07a4a92a9e1fafe7c3.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

61f545197e946131b0250f14.text: Five minutes is a long time in the rain. So is twenty years with the wrong answer.
61f545197e946131b0250f14.speaker: mae
61f545197e946131b0250f14.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

928d7046840174e4d733ee0d.text: Ask for one thing they can see. Don't ask for anybody else's name.
928d7046840174e4d733ee0d.speaker: mae
928d7046840174e4d733ee0d.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

8b2400ce1e380895936f1355.speaker: lev
8b2400ce1e380895936f1355.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

f0fbfdc7cf54058ec7d987c7.text: Yes. Something in front of a pair of living eyes.
f0fbfdc7cf54058ec7d987c7.speaker: mae
f0fbfdc7cf54058ec7d987c7.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

ff4c8c2444afdfa59a0d7286.text: Can you tell us what color the coat is?
ff4c8c2444afdfa59a0d7286.speaker: lev
ff4c8c2444afdfa59a0d7286.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

8cd6ba92221a9091c1bf647a.text: Help me join the three times into one clear call for the posts.
8cd6ba92221a9091c1bf647a.speaker: mae
8cd6ba92221a9091c1bf647a.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

8d13a4be6e3c44035bf3e22c.text: Good. People will have to look down before they speak.
8d13a4be6e3c44035bf3e22c.speaker: mae
8d13a4be6e3c44035bf3e22c.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

87f140b165e63e56094861f6.text: Make them answer one at a time. It isn't a race.
87f140b165e63e56094861f6.speaker: mae
87f140b165e63e56094861f6.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

64bb387de7252d35088b8425.text: You promised him a chair. I kept it warm. I'm here now.
64bb387de7252d35088b8425.speaker: jo
64bb387de7252d35088b8425.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

1ada4699e2f3ce17e03886c1.text: Small boat. Please tell me you remember.
1ada4699e2f3ce17e03886c1.speaker: owen
1ada4699e2f3ce17e03886c1.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

8e4f99b6d6c582a82d8e57c9.text: The line you kept clear brought his voice straight to me. Nell knows where he is.
8e4f99b6d6c582a82d8e57c9.speaker: mae
8e4f99b6d6c582a82d8e57c9.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

cfc32aefbe3caa7a38433a1f.text: I remember the school bench. You used those words.
cfc32aefbe3caa7a38433a1f.speaker: lev
cfc32aefbe3caa7a38433a1f.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

70a89ff2f8d3803829b60bd4.speaker: lev
70a89ff2f8d3803829b60bd4.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

472e4804802f13a98773beab.text: The brake is holding. We can cut the power from outside.
472e4804802f13a98773beab.speaker: nell
472e4804802f13a98773beab.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

0b622469152e044b233b3462.text: My foot is mine. My hand isn't. I don't want to hurt anyone.
0b622469152e044b233b3462.speaker: owen
0b622469152e044b233b3462.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

57ae19e140b7d31daf708cc1.text: May we turn the power off now?
57ae19e140b7d31daf708cc1.speaker: lev
57ae19e140b7d31daf708cc1.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

a22c2d3ac6d09c82907277c6.text: Yes. Ask me, and wait for my yes.
a22c2d3ac6d09c82907277c6.speaker: owen
a22c2d3ac6d09c82907277c6.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

04ba61cb64f4069f80eaf453.text: Now. I said it with my own mouth.
04ba61cb64f4069f80eaf453.speaker: owen
04ba61cb64f4069f80eaf453.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

5a3c984f04ac7d0f4c60987b.text: Read the safety card for me while I keep a hand on the outside switch.
5a3c984f04ac7d0f4c60987b.speaker: nell
5a3c984f04ac7d0f4c60987b.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

7e87ce729481fe1b2022755c.text: I heard his yes. The engine is off.
7e87ce729481fe1b2022755c.speaker: nell
7e87ce729481fe1b2022755c.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

025100fd50d39a9251bdb136.text: He went toward the back exit. I can see his cap.
025100fd50d39a9251bdb136.speaker: lev
025100fd50d39a9251bdb136.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

5f134226c2a817cc4342f8fb.text: Don't send everybody after one cap. Put one guide at each end.
5f134226c2a817cc4342f8fb.speaker: nell
5f134226c2a817cc4342f8fb.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

ab692dca53488543429f0841.speaker: lev
ab692dca53488543429f0841.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

86f27f323876db7bfdaf9b53.text: I can hear him breathing on the old desk line. He's close to the lower gate.
86f27f323876db7bfdaf9b53.speaker: mae
86f27f323876db7bfdaf9b53.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

8216ba23792cd39cdbe2ed38.text: I don't know. Let me send a sound that belongs to today.
8216ba23792cd39cdbe2ed38.speaker: mae
8216ba23792cd39cdbe2ed38.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

03a4adec7f5251593d56b335.text: He went toward the lower gate. I saw his cap on the way.
03a4adec7f5251593d56b335.speaker: lev
03a4adec7f5251593d56b335.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

1dd1f7c67d1904d986ae846f.text: I'm checking the old kitchen line. Read the order on it so we know which sound gets through.
1dd1f7c67d1904d986ae846f.speaker: mae
1dd1f7c67d1904d986ae846f.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

249bc3812ef917c609e0ad1e.text: One ring, then silence. Give him room to answer.
249bc3812ef917c609e0ad1e.speaker: mae
249bc3812ef917c609e0ad1e.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

d095e32ad7572a44328d7f75.text: Sing it yourself. A recording won't know when to stop.
d095e32ad7572a44328d7f75.speaker: mae
d095e32ad7572a44328d7f75.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

d5f167c2939b8f5b4d704ef8.text: I'll go with whoever is keeping his promise to Owen. Another pair of hands matters here.
d5f167c2939b8f5b4d704ef8.speaker: nell
d5f167c2939b8f5b4d704ef8.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

b8c75dc8a91b10308c21164f.text: Can we still help if the rope isn't there?
b8c75dc8a91b10308c21164f.speaker: lev
b8c75dc8a91b10308c21164f.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

92b4d9ecba9fc8455fa7492c.text: The front floor is under water. The back way is shorter, if there's a rope.
92b4d9ecba9fc8455fa7492c.speaker: ruth
92b4d9ecba9fc8455fa7492c.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

e0a690d7b9212dbe7fe5fc92.text: They do. Bring the light you have.
e0a690d7b9212dbe7fe5fc92.speaker: nell
e0a690d7b9212dbe7fe5fc92.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

b2d5268098eb6a7e157704e9.text: If somebody's already with him, yes. From both ends. Otherwise we'll be too late.
b2d5268098eb6a7e157704e9.speaker: nell
b2d5268098eb6a7e157704e9.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

2fe60e724e78b53bc8c230bf.text: Then the things we did before we got here matter now.
2fe60e724e78b53bc8c230bf.speaker: lev
2fe60e724e78b53bc8c230bf.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

eb84bf2de3780ebef244e3c7.text: If the rope holds, we can reach the lower step.
eb84bf2de3780ebef244e3c7.speaker: lev
eb84bf2de3780ebef244e3c7.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

146b7d24461ed3446c382790.text: Call the water level. I'll work from the other side.
146b7d24461ed3446c382790.speaker: nell
146b7d24461ed3446c382790.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

5bcbed2c537a4dacaf485737.text: Read the public trail card. Don't send family landmarks out on the radio.
5bcbed2c537a4dacaf485737.speaker: nell
5bcbed2c537a4dacaf485737.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

5b8cec81f117b360f99b288d.text: Tell me when I can see the end of your light.
5b8cec81f117b360f99b288d.speaker: nell
5b8cec81f117b360f99b288d.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

c7afaf22621b460cfcba4400.text: My hat went ahead without me.
c7afaf22621b460cfcba4400.speaker: owen
c7afaf22621b460cfcba4400.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

4b5eb6565de6458630f58ef8.text: Jo had his shoulders. The rope had mine. All three of us came out.
4b5eb6565de6458630f58ef8.speaker: nell
4b5eb6565de6458630f58ef8.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

f4ab0fac5cf38ea8c23852f6.text: I caught his coat. I lost Dad's pin, not Owen.
f4ab0fac5cf38ea8c23852f6.speaker: jo
f4ab0fac5cf38ea8c23852f6.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

8d43c19d6808f11e52481da4.text: You can be sad about that pin. I am.
8d43c19d6808f11e52481da4.speaker: owen
8d43c19d6808f11e52481da4.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

99030cbf9e7cfe23cdb2d335.speaker: lev
99030cbf9e7cfe23cdb2d335.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

e941c64961b4c5ec278baf90.text: Owen Kerr. I'll tell his family myself.
e941c64961b4c5ec278baf90.speaker: mae
e941c64961b4c5ec278baf90.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

8f372f7b817e58efe1572d60.text: The rope was there. He caught it himself. His wrist is hurt, but he's outside.
8f372f7b817e58efe1572d60.speaker: nell
8f372f7b817e58efe1572d60.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

fb3c9d03476d0816d517319c.text: I reached him after the step fell. He died there. I saw his face.
fb3c9d03476d0816d517319c.speaker: nell
fb3c9d03476d0816d517319c.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

08e3ce5d3e1a40e83db9cfe7.text: Tell me what happened. I can listen.
08e3ce5d3e1a40e83db9cfe7.speaker: lev
08e3ce5d3e1a40e83db9cfe7.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

bd66e52090c4af922d9cb750.text: The lower post wants a name.
bd66e52090c4af922d9cb750.speaker: mae
bd66e52090c4af922d9cb750.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

dbbf7b96601e139cf327261c.text: Listen to the whole sentence. Sometimes the last word changes it.
dbbf7b96601e139cf327261c.speaker: nell
dbbf7b96601e139cf327261c.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

a0d1a36a1851c4632c8b48c1.text: Tell them where we are first. We can take a minute for the name.
a0d1a36a1851c4632c8b48c1.speaker: lev
a0d1a36a1851c4632c8b48c1.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

166eeba995147606c379d6ae.text: Keep your light on my hands. I need to see what I'm holding.
166eeba995147606c379d6ae.speaker: nell
166eeba995147606c379d6ae.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

0fa0984718e3247a31f70620.text: Nell was holding the light when the first nail moved.
0fa0984718e3247a31f70620.speaker: lev
0fa0984718e3247a31f70620.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

d8b9f54ee97d44d5abfa2f34.text: Don't tell me what I should feel. Just hold the light.
d8b9f54ee97d44d5abfa2f34.speaker: nell
d8b9f54ee97d44d5abfa2f34.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

f019e045524b692256c1138f.text: Look at me when you tell me. I want your own words.
f019e045524b692256c1138f.speaker: mae
f019e045524b692256c1138f.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

69aeb6667063190f67937219.text: Tea has a place at this table too.
69aeb6667063190f67937219.speaker: jo
69aeb6667063190f67937219.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

0eaf360b82385458b21bf494.text: I'll sit by it for a minute.
0eaf360b82385458b21bf494.speaker: mae
0eaf360b82385458b21bf494.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

16db2566fc3f92dd8f4f103a.text: I'm here for tea. You don't have to turn me into a story yet.
16db2566fc3f92dd8f4f103a.speaker: owen
16db2566fc3f92dd8f4f103a.direction: Owen, a middle-aged British bus driver. A tired, kind, grounded male voice.

f65453ea8aac300536a3996a.text: We can leave his chair here. We don't have to serve him food he can't eat.
f65453ea8aac300536a3996a.speaker: jo
f65453ea8aac300536a3996a.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

9f5b1aae975409f3e57f9fd3.text: I can set a table. I can't make a room understand a sentence.
9f5b1aae975409f3e57f9fd3.speaker: jo
9f5b1aae975409f3e57f9fd3.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

560eac6b3448fe95ec1a6b50.speaker: lev
560eac6b3448fe95ec1a6b50.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

6f840e686530230a04bce997.text: That's a good order for hard words.
6f840e686530230a04bce997.speaker: jo
6f840e686530230a04bce997.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

2c034216746535a058e1e168.text: One place at this table is Owen's. What comes next?
2c034216746535a058e1e168.speaker: jo
2c034216746535a058e1e168.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

8cbe80bd020babee66098640.text: What happened at the exit. Then what we can do now.
8cbe80bd020babee66098640.speaker: lev
