ede47081ee56d3a41b0e3e5c.speaker: jo
ede47081ee56d3a41b0e3e5c.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

c02cbc66033ead7b2ef5c0ab.text: Then a person can be missing in a full room.
c02cbc66033ead7b2ef5c0ab.speaker: lev
c02cbc66033ead7b2ef5c0ab.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

95f903de6272e08f78d10b08.text: Yes. That's why I'm standing where you can see my face.
95f903de6272e08f78d10b08.speaker: jo
95f903de6272e08f78d10b08.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

7cff2156ef60813bf7e4b5b9.text: I'd like to put one thing back where it belongs.
7cff2156ef60813bf7e4b5b9.speaker: lev
7cff2156ef60813bf7e4b5b9.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

2d90a7f3b1a02687af56a2bc.text: The view from here is worse than the view from the front.
2d90a7f3b1a02687af56a2bc.speaker: lev
2d90a7f3b1a02687af56a2bc.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

5175a1ba2612e719904f7037.text: Read me the Kerrs' sports card from behind the driver's seat.
5175a1ba2612e719904f7037.speaker: jo
5175a1ba2612e719904f7037.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

2c54adc58a464f55d0aa66a2.text: Right side up. The letter K belongs on the inside.
2c54adc58a464f55d0aa66a2.speaker: jo
2c54adc58a464f55d0aa66a2.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

03b283f3ebf9891a48435fcc.text: Put it beside the picture with the teeth.
03b283f3ebf9891a48435fcc.speaker: jo
03b283f3ebf9891a48435fcc.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

38fd0b9ef88cc8ec9f5e3057.text: Can you sign that you heard my words?
38fd0b9ef88cc8ec9f5e3057.speaker: ilya
38fd0b9ef88cc8ec9f5e3057.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

b2f78de047a1b2a5fe9edd19.text: “I said they were safe.” The words “I said” are missing.
b2f78de047a1b2a5fe9edd19.speaker: ilya
b2f78de047a1b2a5fe9edd19.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

e4036cb1a2196015a96eb2e4.text: I heard them. I don't understand the last line. Say it again, please.
e4036cb1a2196015a96eb2e4.speaker: lev
e4036cb1a2196015a96eb2e4.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

2e941f4bf92b09d885cc6d24.text: Then I can't sign this one.
2e941f4bf92b09d885cc6d24.speaker: lev
2e941f4bf92b09d885cc6d24.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

b1f19a1234ecdfd8e0162c12.text: Let's write a line we can both read.
b1f19a1234ecdfd8e0162c12.speaker: lev
b1f19a1234ecdfd8e0162c12.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

2c3c9c8e528de90cb7c22b96.text: Thank you. I asked you to repeat things on your first night. You just did it for me.
2c3c9c8e528de90cb7c22b96.speaker: ilya
2c3c9c8e528de90cb7c22b96.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

adf60e84e47545988d1de49b.text: Could you tell me what you said about the three people?
adf60e84e47545988d1de49b.speaker: lev
adf60e84e47545988d1de49b.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

087a7bc941ec83f3ae522478.text: I'll write every word this time. Watch my hand.
087a7bc941ec83f3ae522478.speaker: ilya
087a7bc941ec83f3ae522478.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

deafc401bd58b09859fb37e1.text: We can speak to the town if a witness wants to stand there.
deafc401bd58b09859fb37e1.speaker: mae
deafc401bd58b09859fb37e1.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

2d9a6a205e0710dc7f81347b.text: I said they were safe. That's the sentence I can sign.
2d9a6a205e0710dc7f81347b.speaker: ilya
2d9a6a205e0710dc7f81347b.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

be5bc1a5be6c227676fa4c41.text: Families can have a named report if the clean copy is still with us.
be5bc1a5be6c227676fa4c41.speaker: nell
be5bc1a5be6c227676fa4c41.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

5c3021ac69202d888de3420d.text: My own statement is ready either way. I'm here even if this room is empty.
5c3021ac69202d888de3420d.speaker: ilya
5c3021ac69202d888de3420d.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

01b2e9c0fecf0a30cf261458.text: I know what we have and who has said yes. Give me a minute to choose.
01b2e9c0fecf0a30cf261458.speaker: lev
01b2e9c0fecf0a30cf261458.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

ae1c8b8ea1a88bfd181b459c.text: Take it. Nobody is waiting for a name on the radio now.
ae1c8b8ea1a88bfd181b459c.speaker: mae
ae1c8b8ea1a88bfd181b459c.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

bba4d9bd4cb652b27a88d25e.text: That's the first quiet minute I've had since I got here.
bba4d9bd4cb652b27a88d25e.speaker: lev
bba4d9bd4cb652b27a88d25e.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

a6c66a092a6f8dff3dbd12bd.text: If we have the copy, the families can each get a page.
a6c66a092a6f8dff3dbd12bd.speaker: lev
a6c66a092a6f8dff3dbd12bd.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

038475eb3f15ffb3dd775542.text: Read the whole answer. A condition is part of a yes.
038475eb3f15ffb3dd775542.speaker: mae
038475eb3f15ffb3dd775542.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

49b35cc65e128f0db5537170.text: Check what we have, including a real empty space.
49b35cc65e128f0db5537170.speaker: nell
49b35cc65e128f0db5537170.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

c2f50d8c8dc225f249f28333.text: I'd like the town to hear Ada in her own words.
c2f50d8c8dc225f249f28333.speaker: lev
c2f50d8c8dc225f249f28333.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

04cae8b97f7f2ae2073eccec.text: Leave a chair for me, not a name on a chair.
04cae8b97f7f2ae2073eccec.speaker: ada
04cae8b97f7f2ae2073eccec.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

52676e45f35a449952947744.text: I'll sit where she can see me. I won't speak for her.
52676e45f35a449952947744.speaker: ruth
52676e45f35a449952947744.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

8a6807e517b4a5ce83afa612.text: I want the families to have the pages with their own names.
8a6807e517b4a5ce83afa612.speaker: lev
8a6807e517b4a5ce83afa612.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

883fb7c61abe6bf1f5468867.text: Give each family its own envelope. They can choose what to do with it.
883fb7c61abe6bf1f5468867.speaker: nell
883fb7c61abe6bf1f5468867.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

e169ff2e1518b903419a12d1.text: Put Luis on mine. Write it with an s.
e169ff2e1518b903419a12d1.speaker: jo
e169ff2e1518b903419a12d1.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

ae72f919c6cf3c5a7eec448d.text: I want to hear the whole thing from you, here.
ae72f919c6cf3c5a7eec448d.speaker: lev
ae72f919c6cf3c5a7eec448d.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

89b75a512823492e6b6a658b.text: Then sit at my end of the table. Nobody has to stand for this.
89b75a512823492e6b6a658b.speaker: ilya
89b75a512823492e6b6a658b.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

d08586a7dc361691c20b8f7d.text: Yes. This one is for you.
d08586a7dc361691c20b8f7d.speaker: ilya
d08586a7dc361691c20b8f7d.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

2cff2655bacdb326f187dd54.text: Will Mae still have Ruth's statement?
2cff2655bacdb326f187dd54.speaker: lev
2cff2655bacdb326f187dd54.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

62be188fed97d07927a5d2b2.speaker: jo
62be188fed97d07927a5d2b2.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

fc628aa1c45d3c22eeb4be64.text: This morning I said it because I didn't know what else to say.
fc628aa1c45d3c22eeb4be64.speaker: lev
fc628aa1c45d3c22eeb4be64.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

c062bd44c503ea52d2316b7e.text: Now I'd like her to sit down.
c062bd44c503ea52d2316b7e.speaker: lev
c062bd44c503ea52d2316b7e.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

95ad75e448bf2dc7fc0ecc2b.text: You can say hello twice in a small town. You might mean it a different way the second time.
95ad75e448bf2dc7fc0ecc2b.speaker: jo
95ad75e448bf2dc7fc0ecc2b.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

a1c3728690ce2e133e7b8d27.text: The chair is yours if you want it.
a1c3728690ce2e133e7b8d27.speaker: lev
a1c3728690ce2e133e7b8d27.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

d504c742e05f20b198c10963.text: Then tell her that. Here, take the chair that doesn't rock.
d504c742e05f20b198c10963.speaker: jo
d504c742e05f20b198c10963.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

047df5d48594fd0e440ee147.text: Read our meeting kitchen note. We'll have enough food however the chairs are set.
047df5d48594fd0e440ee147.speaker: jo
047df5d48594fd0e440ee147.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

e69e59999b5e0dda18cc234b.text: She can leave when she wants. That's a good seat.
e69e59999b5e0dda18cc234b.speaker: jo
e69e59999b5e0dda18cc234b.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

2eac419fcc530fe6c1780700.text: She can see where the lower road used to be.
2eac419fcc530fe6c1780700.speaker: jo
2eac419fcc530fe6c1780700.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

c0d195794fe10246ea7ca9a2.text: I was the one who told the desk to mark them safe.
c0d195794fe10246ea7ca9a2.speaker: ruth
c0d195794fe10246ea7ca9a2.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

9f865410c5e5e891e50bd4cc.text: I saw the children come in. I did not see Ben, Luis or Dot come in. Those two sentences can share a page.
9f865410c5e5e891e50bd4cc.speaker: ada
9f865410c5e5e891e50bd4cc.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

85be7d00bfdbbd223caf65b2.text: Now put your name next to that, Ruth, the way I put mine next to mine.
85be7d00bfdbbd223caf65b2.speaker: ada
85be7d00bfdbbd223caf65b2.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

e43fc36830d6e68831e1b9f4.text: Dad's name in my hand feels different from Dad's name on a wall.
e43fc36830d6e68831e1b9f4.speaker: jo
e43fc36830d6e68831e1b9f4.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

7c69287452bc8cbf2b48f158.text: I want mine shut until breakfast. I want to choose where I read it.
7c69287452bc8cbf2b48f158.speaker: ada
7c69287452bc8cbf2b48f158.direction: Ada, a young adult British woman. Gentle, thoughtful and quietly determined.

213a899bfce60c5707126f06.text: Tell us if anyone asks for all three names at once. We can say the pages went home.
213a899bfce60c5707126f06.speaker: nell
213a899bfce60c5707126f06.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

76b887e88df2fb0ca2ff8854.text: I keep fixing things for the boy who isn't here anymore.
76b887e88df2fb0ca2ff8854.speaker: ilya
76b887e88df2fb0ca2ff8854.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

50ec19ec767ef3a944093c22.text: I'm here. Just taller. Start with the bridge.
50ec19ec767ef3a944093c22.speaker: lev
50ec19ec767ef3a944093c22.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

518276a3a7d983efe2b45bf6.text: There's one more line. Do you want to read it?
518276a3a7d983efe2b45bf6.speaker: lev
518276a3a7d983efe2b45bf6.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

9406ff74b02766472b83345a.text: Do you want to remember it?
9406ff74b02766472b83345a.speaker: lev
9406ff74b02766472b83345a.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

ff9c9369a267b70226134833.text: I wanted a whole story. He gave me three things to buy and a phone number.
ff9c9369a267b70226134833.speaker: jo
ff9c9369a267b70226134833.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

3e345c843fd18c08f818f2a0.text: He wanted to make up with me. I can't remember the fight.
3e345c843fd18c08f818f2a0.speaker: jo
3e345c843fd18c08f818f2a0.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

f2103942410ad401a5525a7f.text: I turned back. Nobody told me to lie when I got home. I chose it on my own.
f2103942410ad401a5525a7f.speaker: ilya
f2103942410ad401a5525a7f.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

2aadf53471d9841f51ba4656.text: Dad wrote that line before he left the kitchen.
2aadf53471d9841f51ba4656.speaker: lev
2aadf53471d9841f51ba4656.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

adfd714368e2422a422a9533.text: No. I like knowing he wanted to make up. That's enough for one day.
adfd714368e2422a422a9533.speaker: jo
adfd714368e2422a422a9533.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

5ea44c9725e5247f9e9c0026.text: I'll fold it back in the sleeve. I can open it again.
5ea44c9725e5247f9e9c0026.speaker: jo
5ea44c9725e5247f9e9c0026.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

9c8a8b3e5d359887b65ad6bc.text: Luis Park. Please read it back.
9c8a8b3e5d359887b65ad6bc.speaker: jo
9c8a8b3e5d359887b65ad6bc.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

3badf999481b584f097441dd.text: Good. Somebody can make that dinner for me one day.
3badf999481b584f097441dd.speaker: jo
3badf999481b584f097441dd.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

a7f6f68bc0e04390681aca19.text: Luis Park. No one saw him arrive at the upper school.
a7f6f68bc0e04390681aca19.speaker: ruth
a7f6f68bc0e04390681aca19.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

bf7f2aece561c75030b0e78c.text: Does the page say anything else?
bf7f2aece561c75030b0e78c.speaker: ilya
bf7f2aece561c75030b0e78c.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

21004975552dade63d93f8c6.text: Good. Leave the rest of my father's letter with me.
21004975552dade63d93f8c6.speaker: jo
21004975552dade63d93f8c6.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

e1f0d800cd1ca7859f9e8a55.text: Then we'll stop where you want.
e1f0d800cd1ca7859f9e8a55.speaker: lev
e1f0d800cd1ca7859f9e8a55.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

851edc3cd21f096c0b21642c.text: Luis Park. Last seen walking toward the lower shelter. That's what I can take home.
851edc3cd21f096c0b21642c.speaker: jo
851edc3cd21f096c0b21642c.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

d690c5ad7dc82418d18e2717.text: You can have the cloth. The words stay with me.
d690c5ad7dc82418d18e2717.speaker: jo
d690c5ad7dc82418d18e2717.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

fae99f002259ca1f3ff6c8da.text: One private line from his sleeve. That belongs to me.
fae99f002259ca1f3ff6c8da.speaker: jo
fae99f002259ca1f3ff6c8da.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

fab47e2d666a0693a280e645.text: Then the recording will feel like something from a kitchen.
fab47e2d666a0693a280e645.speaker: lev
fab47e2d666a0693a280e645.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

1feadc80d896cff14664d4a6.text: That's where most of us tell the truth a little at a time.
1feadc80d896cff14664d4a6.speaker: jo
1feadc80d896cff14664d4a6.direction: Jo, an adult British man. Clear, practical, steady and approachable.

d1beb472d1b3a11dc7275a65.text: My dad made it for a child. I kept it because it asked nothing of me.
d1beb472d1b3a11dc7275a65.speaker: mae
d1beb472d1b3a11dc7275a65.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

50a1d457b9b8071e7147479c.text: You can take the hook too. I saved the wall paint under it.
50a1d457b9b8071e7147479c.speaker: ilya
50a1d457b9b8071e7147479c.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

0be77888bf6e3735f5af1fb1.text: What will you do when there's no wall?
0be77888bf6e3735f5af1fb1.speaker: lev
0be77888bf6e3735f5af1fb1.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

55cade571d67664bc9fe1278.text: It still has your dad's marks on it.
55cade571d67664bc9fe1278.speaker: lev
55cade571d67664bc9fe1278.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

cf05b38df2e8b07232c2b60a.text: Put it on my desk. I hear the real keys there all day. One quiet key might be nice.
cf05b38df2e8b07232c2b60a.speaker: mae
cf05b38df2e8b07232c2b60a.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

1c31fb2cdeb292b23b9da3c5.text: That's why I didn't get a new one.
1c31fb2cdeb292b23b9da3c5.speaker: mae
1c31fb2cdeb292b23b9da3c5.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

abc39b91abab3c078afbf1f1.text: Here's the key. Please put it away in the blue cloth.
abc39b91abab3c078afbf1f1.speaker: lev
abc39b91abab3c078afbf1f1.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

db3cf09ef27ba9bc303d91ce.text: Put it where I can reach it with either hand.
db3cf09ef27ba9bc303d91ce.speaker: mae
db3cf09ef27ba9bc303d91ce.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

0b21144f6df54c351c8410a8.text: And if it's my name that's wrong?
0b21144f6df54c351c8410a8.speaker: ruth
0b21144f6df54c351c8410a8.direction: Ruth, a mature British woman. Composed, authoritative, measured and careful.

5bb67b1778d69b6eaebe81d6.text: Read the final tool list. I want my small key packed with the same care as the radio.
5bb67b1778d69b6eaebe81d6.speaker: mae
5bb67b1778d69b6eaebe81d6.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

c5145a9935dc7f7e8fd53ed9.text: Use the blue cloth. It used to hold my best tools.
c5145a9935dc7f7e8fd53ed9.speaker: ilya
c5145a9935dc7f7e8fd53ed9.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.

909749bcbe660d6100fc94ac.text: If a name is wrong, come to this desk and tell me. You won't have to shout across a room.
909749bcbe660d6100fc94ac.speaker: mae
909749bcbe660d6100fc94ac.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

40f1af83149b6921e3762f43.text: You get the same chair as anybody else.
40f1af83149b6921e3762f43.speaker: mae
40f1af83149b6921e3762f43.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

bda830f8c9fe895c016f5caa.speaker: lev
bda830f8c9fe895c016f5caa.direction: Lev, a thoughtful young adult man. Curious, understated, attentive. Clear English.

cf0ffbd311fa1bf7c417c4b6.text: A person can bring a correction without giving the whole town a key.
cf0ffbd311fa1bf7c417c4b6.speaker: nell
cf0ffbd311fa1bf7c417c4b6.direction: Nell, an adult British woman. Lively, direct, friendly but perceptive.

3a4eb59acc072feb2d49b64b.text: I'll keep one hour for those visits. Knock once and wait for my own answer.
3a4eb59acc072feb2d49b64b.speaker: mae
3a4eb59acc072feb2d49b64b.direction: Mae, an adult British dispatcher. Calm, precise, observant female voice.

f744d8cab49b847afbd3f306.speaker: nell

b6bb4565b808ee8fe27f735d.direction: Ilya, an older man, Lev's uncle. Warm low voice, restrained and sometimes anxious.
